answer: Deposits are visible in shale, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 62 aliases, and each one needs its own funded delta account. A farm of 3265 identities would post 4320 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
